title: First Watch | Nat 20 Pixels C1E6
description:
Four strangers, one campfire, and a long night in Thornpike Woods.
No goblins tonight. Just the things people notice about each other in the dark.

Episode 6 of a daily pixel-art D&D 5e story. After a raid, a stolen lantern-core, wolves and a goblin camp, Brannoc, Ilsevel, Tamsin and Oriel make their first camp together beside an old stone in a hollow. Somebody reads somebody else's notebook, somebody keeps the first watch, and somebody's shield has a secret under the paint. The few rolls tonight are real, seeded dice shown on screen.

New episode every weekday. Characters, quotes and every roll are on the wiki.
